encounters.title: Lanterns on the Raft
encounters.flavor: At the landing, a flat raft circles without touching shore. Its ferryman keeps a lantern lit in broad daylight, watching the current as though it might change its mind. A stranded family waits behind Zuzu, too frightened to call across the water.

choices.label: Offer to steady the mooring
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to offer to steady the mooring while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: steel check against 8; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu anchors the rope and brings the passengers across in order, earning a packet of river cakes.

failure.text: The rope slips and scalds his palms; the family reaches shore, but Zuzu must cross alone in darkness.

choices.label: Ask why the lantern burns
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to ask why the lantern burns while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: insight check against 9; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The ferryman explains that a submerged channel opens only when the current stills; Zuzu remembers the safer approach.

failure.text: The ferryman mistakes the question for mockery and pushes off, leaving Zuzu on the wrong bank.

encounters.title: The Toll of Two Names
encounters.flavor: A registrar stops every traveler and writes down a name before permitting passage. On the open page, Zuzu sees the same pair of names repeated years apart, each in a different hand. No coin is requested, which makes the queue more uneasy.

choices.label: Demand an honest account
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to demand an honest account while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: bearing check against 10; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The registrar shows the crossed-out entries: lost crossings were recorded as debts, and she erases Zuzu's name.

failure.text: The registrar summons guards; Zuzu backs away before they can close the gate, battered by the crush.

choices.label: Copy the ledger quietly
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to copy the ledger quietly while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: awareness check against 10; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu memorizes the altered dates and slips through the line with an answer to one old disappearance.

failure.text: His sleeve catches a wax seal, alerting the guards; the crowd scatters and Zuzu loses his rations.

encounters.title: The Boat That Waits
encounters.flavor: An empty skiff sits tied to a post long after the boats have departed. A boatwright says its owner promised to return before the flood, yet the water has fallen twice since. Every plank is sound except a splintered rudder.

choices.label: Repair the rudder
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to repair the rudder while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: wits check against 8; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The skiff takes the current cleanly and the boatwright gives Zuzu a reliable route through the shallows.

failure.text: A hidden crack splits the timber under strain, striking Zuzu's ankle as the skiff drifts away.

choices.label: Wait for its owner
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to wait for its owner while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: resolve check against 9; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The absent owner's sister arrives and offers testimony about the missing river patrol instead of a fare.

failure.text: Night falls without an answer; Zuzu's vigil costs a meal and reveals only a second unused rope.

encounters.title: Weighed in Salt
encounters.flavor: A trader's scale measures salt by the spoon while a queue of hungry travelers looks on. Each new customer receives less than the last. The merchant insists the fault lies in the shifting floorboards.

choices.label: Test the counterweights
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to test the counterweights while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: wits check against 8; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu finds a stone hidden inside the brass weight; the merchant restores the fair measure to everyone.

failure.text: The merchant's hired hands throw Zuzu into a stack of crates before the cheating can be proved.

choices.label: Trade supplies for passage
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to trade supplies for passage while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: bearing check against 8; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: A calm bargain earns a sealed crossing voucher without surrendering the last provisions.

failure.text: The merchant takes a double measure and leaves Zuzu short of food for the coming trail.

encounters.title: The Mended Compass
encounters.flavor: A cartographer offers to exchange a repaired compass for a map that no longer matches the delta. She admits she has redrawn the river six times and erased only five versions. The sixth is folded beneath her stool.

choices.label: Compare the two charts
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to compare the two charts while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: insight check against 8; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The erased riverbend lines up with a surviving stone marker, giving Zuzu a safer trail.

failure.text: Zuzu trusts the neat chart, only to discover its bridge washed away; the detour costs daylight and strength.

choices.label: Help reset the compass
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to help reset the compass while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: wits check against 9; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The needle steadies, and the cartographer shares a packet of trail markers with her thanks.

failure.text: A magnet hidden in the table skews the reading; Zuzu leaves with an unreliable bearing.

encounters.title: Three Cups on the Table
encounters.flavor: A cook serves three cups of broth: one for the buyer, one for an absent traveler, and one for whoever asks no questions. A pair of armed patrons watch which cup Zuzu chooses. The cook has not touched her own meal.

choices.label: Share the untouched meal
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to share the untouched meal while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: bearing check against 7; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The cook reveals an honest back route and sends Zuzu onward with bread wrapped in cloth.

failure.text: The armed patrons take offense and overturn the table, leaving a bruised Zuzu to gather the scraps.

choices.label: Question the armed patrons
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to question the armed patrons while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: insight check against 9; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: Their account of a vanished caravan contradicts the cook's, exposing a false checkpoint downriver.

failure.text: A patron spits a warning and draws a knife; Zuzu escapes but loses precious time.

encounters.title: Footprints in the Silt
encounters.flavor: A surveyor crouches beside footprints that begin in a dry channel and stop at an empty bank. A row of stakes records last season's waterline, but fresh mud lies higher than any of them. He wants help checking the next marker.

choices.label: Follow the wet prints
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to follow the wet prints while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: awareness check against 9; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The prints lead to a concealed spillway, and Zuzu marks the safe stone route before the water returns.

failure.text: The ground gives way under a salt crust; Zuzu claws clear with a scraped shoulder.

choices.label: Help set new markers
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to help set new markers while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: steel check against 8; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: Together they anchor the stakes, and the surveyor shares a water skin and a practical warning.

failure.text: A sudden current tears away the rope; the tools are lost and Zuzu leaves soaked and aching.

encounters.title: A Road of Bones
encounters.flavor: White ribs of ancient driftwood cross a dry inlet in a pattern too deliberate for a flood. A salvage guide says the structure predates her grandparents, though she refuses to name its makers. Sand rattles beneath the timber.

choices.label: Cross on the old timbers
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to cross on the old timbers while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: steel check against 10; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu finds stable braces beneath the bleached beams and reaches the opposite bank before dusk.

failure.text: A rotten beam splits; his fall leaves him bruised and forces a longer approach through the salt flats.

choices.label: Ask the guide to lead
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to ask the guide to lead while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: bearing check against 8; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The guide admits which sections she reinforced and leads Zuzu safely across for a modest exchange.

failure.text: She vanishes with the advance provisions, leaving Zuzu to find his own difficult route.

encounters.title: The Reed Music
encounters.flavor: Music rises from a place the map labels empty. A lone reed player sits by a trickle of fresh water, claiming the melody helps travelers hear when the buried river is moving. His feet never leave the dry ground.

choices.label: Listen between the notes
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to listen between the notes while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: awareness check against 8; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu hears water beneath the sand and finds a shallow drinking pool beyond the musician's stone.

failure.text: The rising wind drowns the warning notes; he wanders into a gritty gust that steals his breath.

choices.label: Offer an old traveling song
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to offer an old traveling song while respecting the consequences of this meeting.
choices.risk: resolve check against 7; a poor outcome can cost health or provisions.

success.text: The musician answers with a second melody and shows a path that avoids the worst of the crossing.

failure.text: The song attracts a patrol; Zuzu is forced to hide until the heat drains his remaining strength.

encounters.title: Hammer Under Stone
encounters.flavor: The abandoned quarry is not entirely abandoned. A lone mason sounds the rock with an iron hammer and refuses to work near a freshly cut seam. He says someone reopened the quarry at night without marking the supports.

choices.label: Brace the loosened wall
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to brace the loosened wall rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a steel check against 9; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Zuzu wedges a support beneath the cracked shelf and earns a safe passage and a mason's flask.

failure.text: The stone slips before the brace holds, bruising Zuzu's ribs and burying the easy road.

choices.label: Inspect the fresh cuts
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to inspect the fresh cuts rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a insight check against 10; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Chisel marks point toward a hidden side tunnel, revealing that the recent work was deliberate.

failure.text: Loose shale gives away Zuzu's position to unseen miners, forcing a painful retreat.

encounters.title: The Empty Pay Cart
encounters.flavor: An accountant counts pebbles into an empty ore cart where wages should have been. Workers have vanished, but their names remain on a pay sheet pinned beneath his hoof. He offers Zuzu a share to stay quiet.

choices.label: Refuse the crooked bargain
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to refuse the crooked bargain rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a resolve check against 9; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: The accountant relents and shows Zuzu the tunnel where the missing workers last reported.

failure.text: The accountant signals unseen guards; Zuzu escapes through falling stone at the cost of strength.

choices.label: Read the pay sheet aloud
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to read the pay sheet aloud rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a bearing check against 10; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Surviving workers gather, recognize their names, and reclaim the cart and its supplies.

failure.text: The ledger is snatched away and Zuzu is driven into a narrow, dangerous cut.

encounters.title: The Glass Vein
encounters.flavor: A collector works alone at a seam of black glass that sings when struck. She knows the material can cut skin without drawing blood at first. She asks for a steady hand to remove a fragment for the road.

choices.label: Cut a safe sample
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to cut a safe sample rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a wits check against 9; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Zuzu eases a blunt shard free, and the collector marks a sheltered exit in gratitude.

failure.text: The brittle seam fractures; shards scatter against Zuzu's forearms before he can withdraw.

choices.label: Carry the collector's load
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to carry the collector's load rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a steel check against 8; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: They move the tray without breaking a piece and share a meal beyond the quarry rim.

failure.text: A strap snaps on the climb, leaving Zuzu sore from saving the heavy tray.

encounters.title: The Watchful Overhang
encounters.flavor: An ibex scout watches an overhang shed dust with every breeze. She warns that the canyon wall is moving faster than the weather can explain. Travelers behind Zuzu are already entering the shadow.

choices.label: Call the travelers back
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to call the travelers back rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a bearing check against 9; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: The caravan heeds Zuzu, and the scout leads everyone around the crumbling shelf.

failure.text: His warning comes too late; flying gravel bruises him as he shields the last traveler.

choices.label: Test the ledge alone
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to test the ledge alone rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a awareness check against 11; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Zuzu spots the hollow stone beneath the path and marks each safe foothold for those behind.

failure.text: A loose slab pitches him toward the ravine; the rope catches him but tears his hands.

encounters.title: The Banner in the Wind
encounters.flavor: A torn banner hangs above a narrow bridge, tied where no courier would willingly stop. A captain searches for her missing rider and insists the pattern is a distress signal, not a territorial warning.

choices.label: Decode the banner knots
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to decode the banner knots rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a wits check against 10; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: The knots describe an alternate bridge, and the captain shares her last trail ration.

failure.text: The wind twists the fabric into nonsense and Zuzu takes a long, exhausting detour.

choices.label: Search below the bridge
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to search below the bridge rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a awareness check against 11; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Zuzu finds the missing courier alive beneath the span and helps her climb to safety.

failure.text: A false foothold sends Zuzu sliding into a thicket of thorns above the riverbed.

encounters.title: The Toll Without a Keeper
encounters.flavor: A toll rope hangs across the canyon trail, though no guard stands behind it. The enforcer watches from the rocks, waiting to see who pays into an unattended box. Her spear has been deliberately blunted.

choices.label: Challenge the false toll
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to challenge the false toll rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a steel check against 10; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Zuzu cuts the rope without striking her, and the shaken enforcer abandons the extortion.

failure.text: The enforcer's hidden partner catches Zuzu off guard, and he retreats bruised.

choices.label: Offer a fair trade
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to offer a fair trade rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a bearing check against 9; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: She accepts provisions for a reliable warning about the trail ahead and lets the party pass.

failure.text: She takes the payment and sends Zuzu toward a dead-end ledge.

encounters.title: One Place by the Fire
encounters.flavor: A camp has one empty place by its fire and a rule against asking why. The host invites Zuzu to sit, while two exhausted travelers stare into their bowls. Somebody has scraped a name off the signboard.

choices.label: Accept the offered place
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to accept the offered place rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a insight check against 9; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Zuzu notices the missing traveler left by choice, and the host shares a quiet meal and the safer road.

failure.text: An argument erupts over the unspoken rule, and Zuzu loses sleep keeping watch.

choices.label: Ask about the missing name
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to ask about the missing name rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a bearing check against 10; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: The host tells the truth about a vanished guide and gives Zuzu a route around the gorge.

failure.text: The question divides the camp; Zuzu leaves hungry under hostile stares.

encounters.title: The Map in Ashes
encounters.flavor: An archivist feeds torn maps into the fire one corner at a time. She claims every version led a traveler into a trap, but one fragment still bears a recognizable canyon notch. Zuzu has only moments before it burns.

choices.label: Rescue the marked fragment
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to rescue the marked fragment rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a awareness check against 9; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Zuzu lifts the fragment intact and learns which canyon path was deliberately mislabeled.

failure.text: Hot embers burn his wrist, and the important corner collapses into ash.

choices.label: Persuade her to stop
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to persuade her to stop rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a bearing check against 9; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: The archivist admits her fear and shares an untouched chart with the safe camp marked.

failure.text: She refuses and throws the rest into the fire, leaving Zuzu without guidance.

encounters.title: The Night Watch Debt
encounters.flavor: A retired sentry offers to watch the camp in exchange for one night's sleep. His lantern has no lens, yet he walks the perimeter with practiced care. At each circuit he stops to count unfamiliar footsteps.

choices.label: Take the first watch
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to take the first watch rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a resolve check against 10; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: Zuzu catches a creeping thief before the supplies vanish and earns the sentry's respect.

failure.text: Exhaustion blurs the darkness; thieves steal the camp's food while Zuzu fights to stay upright.

choices.label: Follow the counted footsteps
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to follow the counted footsteps rather than ignore the situation and its people.
choices.risk: Risk a awareness check against 10; failure may cost provisions or health.

success.text: The tracks reveal a harmless lost pilgrim, whom Zuzu guides back before panic spreads.

failure.text: Zuzu mistakes echoes for steps, wandering into a cold gully until morning.

encounters.title: Feathers in the Draft
encounters.flavor: At the cave mouth, a crow storm-reader sets paper charms into the wind without letting one blow away. She tells Zuzu the cavern remembers spoken bargains more clearly than faces. A cold current keeps returning from the wrong direction.

choices.label: Answer her question plainly
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to answer her question plainly rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: bearing check against 9; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The storm-reader accepts Zuzu's name and gives him a chalk sign for a safe entrance.

failure.text: His answer echoes from three passages at once, drawing him into a cold pocket where he loses strength.

choices.label: Study the returning draft
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to study the returning draft rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: insight check against 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu locates a narrow vent that explains the echo and marks a practical route below.

failure.text: The draft blows out his lantern, and sharp stone punishes his hurried descent.

encounters.title: The Third Shadow
encounters.flavor: A guide offers to lead Zuzu underground, but three shadows fall behind her from only two lanterns. She insists the third belongs to a traveler who turned back. At the entrance, a line of stones has been rearranged since sunrise.

choices.label: Count the lantern positions
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to count the lantern positions rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: awareness check against 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu finds the hidden third lamp and exposes a staged ambush without drawing his blade.

failure.text: He looks toward the wrong shadow, and a trapper's cord cuts his shoulder as he escapes.

choices.label: Demand a safer passage
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to demand a safer passage rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: resolve check against 9; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The guide abandons the trick and reveals a genuine lower corridor in exchange for mercy.

failure.text: Her accomplices block the gate; Zuzu fights free and loses his spare food.

encounters.title: Shelter for the Storm
encounters.flavor: Rain lashes the ridge where a healer struggles to carry supplies into the cave. She is treating travelers stranded by sudden wind, and her lamp gutters with each gust. Beyond her lies a ledge where the water is already rising.

choices.label: Carry the medicine chest
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to carry the medicine chest rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: steel check against 8; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu bears the chest into shelter and receives a bandage and a careful map of the dry passage.

failure.text: The chest slips on wet stone, bruising his knee before he can lift it again.

choices.label: Guide the stranded travelers
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to guide the stranded travelers rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: bearing check against 9; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The travelers follow his calm directions into shelter and share provisions in thanks.

failure.text: Panic scatters the group; Zuzu spends a cold hour searching the slope and loses a meal.

encounters.title: The Candle Court
encounters.flavor: Deep in the hollow, an adjudicator hears disputes by candlelight. Two miners each claim the same pouch of pale salt, and the witness is missing. The adjudicator asks Zuzu to judge the evidence before either party may leave.

choices.label: Hear both testimonies
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to hear both testimonies rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: insight check against 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu notices an identical tear in the pouch and one miner's sleeve, securing a fair division.

failure.text: He mistakes rehearsed testimony for fact and earns the wrath of the wronged miner.

choices.label: Offer a shared judgment
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to offer a shared judgment rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: bearing check against 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Both miners accept a witnessed bargain, and the adjudicator grants passage without a debt.

failure.text: The miners refuse compromise and the hearing drags through the night, costing Zuzu food.

encounters.title: Salt on the Threshold
encounters.flavor: A mason has painted a thick salt line before a narrow doorway, though the stones behind it appear ordinary. She insists the mark keeps the cavern air from turning poisonous during a pressure shift. Her measurements are scratched into slate.

choices.label: Reinforce the vent above
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to reinforce the vent above rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: wits check against 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu opens the vent without disturbing the seal, and the mason offers a useful route onward.

failure.text: The seal breaks under the chisel, filling the room with stinging dust before he can withdraw.

choices.label: Test the air carefully
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to test the air carefully rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: awareness check against 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: A faint mineral odor confirms the warning, and Zuzu finds a clean bypass along the upper shelf.

failure.text: His test is too slow and the chalked passage floods with dust, leaving him coughing.

encounters.title: The Forgotten Pledge
encounters.flavor: A guardian stands before a sealed chamber, repeating an oath in a voice he no longer recognizes. The iron charm on his wrist glows only when he tries to leave. Whatever grips him was imposed by a ritual, not his ancestry.

choices.label: Speak the oath back to him
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to speak the oath back to him rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: resolve check against 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu steadies the guardian long enough for him to remember who bound the charm and open the safe way.

failure.text: The binding surges through the chamber; Zuzu survives the guardian's involuntary blow but limps onward.

choices.label: Examine the iron charm
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to examine the iron charm rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: wits check against 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu spots a removable fastening and frees the guardian without demanding payment.

failure.text: A false clasp snaps shut, and Zuzu takes a painful shock before breaking away.

encounters.title: Three Doors Without Hinges
encounters.flavor: Three stone arches stand where four tunnels ought to meet. An architect traces the missing route with her chain, explaining that earthquakes shift the intersections while their destinations remain. Her diagram is accurate only for this hour.

choices.label: Compare the chain marks
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to compare the chain marks rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: wits check against 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu identifies the stable arch by its old fracture and records the new arrangement for return.

failure.text: The chain snags beneath a moving slab, and Zuzu escapes the narrowing corridor with bruises.

choices.label: Ask for a witness to the path
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to ask for a witness to the path rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: bearing check against 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The architect sends a novice with Zuzu, ensuring neither can later deny which passage was chosen.

failure.text: Her apprentice refuses; Zuzu must choose alone and sacrifices a night's rest to the maze.

encounters.title: Voices Across the Rock
encounters.flavor: A courier calls from behind a sheet of stone, though his voice reaches the wrong tunnel. He claims to have a letter for a village beyond the cave, and a second voice repeats his words a moment later. The sheet vibrates with underground thunder.

choices.label: Trace the true echo
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to trace the true echo rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: awareness check against 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu finds the thin rock at the real source and leads the courier into open air.

failure.text: The false echo draws him into falling grit and leaves him with a painful scrape.

choices.label: Signal a safe meeting point
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to signal a safe meeting point rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: resolve check against 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The courier follows deliberate taps through the branching corridors and shares a spare meal.

failure.text: The signal is drowned by thunder, and Zuzu spends his provisions keeping the search alive.

encounters.title: The Red Vial
encounters.flavor: An exhausted pilgrim guards a red vial while asking strangers not to come too close. He says the liquid holds back a hunger placed upon him by a sorcerer. His trembling hands make the flask seem more dangerous than his size.

choices.label: Help secure the vial
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to help secure the vial rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: steel check against 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu braces the flask in a leather cradle; the pilgrim recovers and points out an unguarded tunnel.

failure.text: The vial nearly shatters, and the pilgrim shoves Zuzu away in panicked self-defense.

choices.label: Ask about the binding spell
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to ask about the binding spell rather than leave this encounter unanswered.
choices.risk: insight check against 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu recognizes a practical counter-sign among the scratches and gives the pilgrim a safer ritual to attempt.

failure.text: The pilgrim mistakes the question for an accusation, and the encounter ends in a desperate struggle.

encounters.title: The Cooling Stones
encounters.flavor: The black road retains warmth long after sunset. A road mender taps a line of stones that glow faintly under her tool, warning Zuzu that an old fissure opens when the ground cools. The next caravan is already approaching.

choices.label: Mark the unsafe seam
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to mark the unsafe seam with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: awareness check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu traces a safe detour and signals the caravan before the fissure opens.

failure.text: The road parts beneath his boots and cuts his leg before he can retreat.

choices.label: Help lay a new crossing
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to help lay a new crossing with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: steel check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Together they place sturdy slabs over the gap and share water in the renewed shade.

failure.text: The slabs shift under their weight, forcing a painful climb and wasting the day's supplies.

encounters.title: A Mirror in the Ash
encounters.flavor: A scavenger turns a mirror toward the empty road and watches dust gather on its surface. She claims it shows travelers what they have already lost, though her own reflection remains ordinary. Beside the mirror lie several discarded letters.

choices.label: Read the discarded letters
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to read the discarded letters with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: insight check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu finds a map reference among the letters, not an answer to the world's older mysteries.

failure.text: Wind tears the letters apart before Zuzu can put them in order, leaving him exposed on the ridge.

choices.label: Trade a true memory
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to trade a true memory with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: resolve check versus 12; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The scavenger accepts his honest recollection and points out a sheltered route past the ruins.

failure.text: The exchange shakes him with grief and distraction; he stumbles onward exhausted.

encounters.title: Ashes at the Border
encounters.flavor: A ranger stops Zuzu where ash drifts across the road like snow. She guards a damaged watchtower and insists that no one is permitted through until the signal horn is repaired. Her comrades left hours ago for water.

choices.label: Repair the signal horn
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to repair the signal horn with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: wits check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu clears the damaged valve, and the ranger sounds a warning that opens the road.

failure.text: The horn breaks further in his hands and the stranded ranger demands compensation he cannot pay.

choices.label: Offer to scout the tower
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to offer to scout the tower with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: awareness check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: From the tower Zuzu spots an approaching dust front and guides the ranger to safety.

failure.text: The stairs crumble under him, and he escapes the falling stones bruised and coughing.

encounters.title: The Last Watchfire
encounters.flavor: The camp's final watchfire burns low despite plenty of wood. Its commander says the guards refuse to light a second flame while refugees are still missing outside the barricade. Her sabre rests untouched beside the gate.

choices.label: Volunteer for the search
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to volunteer for the search with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: resolve check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu follows quiet calls into the dark and returns with the missing refugees.

failure.text: He reaches the ravine too late and returns shaken and scraped by the narrow path.

choices.label: Organize the watch rota
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to organize the watch rota with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: bearing check versus 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The camp accepts a fair division of duty, and fresh guards bring food from the stores.

failure.text: Distrust splits the patrol and Zuzu is sent away before a new watch can be arranged.

encounters.title: The Closed Infirmary
encounters.flavor: A field physician keeps wounded travelers outside an infirmary whose door has been nailed shut. She insists the room is contaminated, but the only available bandages are inside. Several guards accuse her of inventing the danger.

choices.label: Inspect the sealed room
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to inspect the sealed room with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: insight check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu discovers spoiled herbs rather than a plague, and the clean supplies are recovered safely.

failure.text: He forces the door too quickly and inhales bitter fumes that leave him weak.

choices.label: Calm the waiting guards
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to calm the waiting guards with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: bearing check versus 10; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The guards help carry fresh supplies to the wounded instead of breaking the door.

failure.text: The crowd panics and overturns the wagon; Zuzu takes a blow in the crush.

encounters.title: The Prisoner of Dusk
encounters.flavor: Guards hold a scout whose eyes flash red whenever the sun touches the copper wire on his wrists. A medic says the reaction began after an encounter with an occult relic. The commander fears what will happen at sundown.

choices.label: Question the scout quietly
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to question the scout quietly with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: insight check versus 12; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu learns the relic's location and persuades the commander to loosen the binding under supervision.

failure.text: The scout loses control of his voice and the frightened guards strike before Zuzu can intervene.

choices.label: Secure the copper restraint
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to secure the copper restraint with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: wits check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu rebuilds the damaged clasp without harming the captive, buying time for a healer.

failure.text: The clasp burns through his glove and the camp drives him away from the prisoner.

encounters.title: The Key Without a Door
encounters.flavor: An archivist waits beside an unmarked gate and holds out a key carved from stone. She says the key belongs to a door no one can locate twice. Behind her, faded carvings show travelers arriving from different directions.

choices.label: Read the worn carving
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to read the worn carving with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: insight check versus 12; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu identifies a recurring mark that aligns the gate with the path he actually walked.

failure.text: The pattern vanishes beneath his rubbing, and the archivist sends him toward a dangerous side passage.

choices.label: Ask who forged the key
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to ask who forged the key with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: bearing check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The archivist admits she does not know its makers but shows how to approach the gate safely.

failure.text: She hears accusation in his question and closes the audience, leaving him without supplies.

encounters.title: A Promise Kept
encounters.flavor: A messenger rests just short of the final gate, guarding a letter that has crossed several kingdoms. Its recipient may already have vanished, but the promise to deliver it remains. She asks Zuzu whether a duty can survive the loss of its purpose.

choices.label: Carry the sealed letter
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to carry the sealed letter with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: resolve check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu accepts the burden without opening the seal, and the messenger shares the final safe directions.

failure.text: The weight of another promise distracts him; a misstep costs him strength in the narrow pass.

choices.label: Help search for its owner
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to help search for its owner with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: awareness check versus 12; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: They find a sign left by the recipient and follow a more certain road to the threshold.

failure.text: The search yields only old tracks, and the delay consumes their last meal.

encounters.title: The Price of Silence
encounters.flavor: A negotiator offers passage on one condition: Zuzu must promise never to speak of what he sees beyond the gate. No contract names the powers behind it. She waits without anger as the black stones cool at her feet.

choices.label: Refuse the secret bargain
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to refuse the secret bargain with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: resolve check versus 12; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: Zuzu refuses to surrender his judgment and finds an unbound route around the negotiator's seal.

failure.text: The negotiator closes the direct gate and Zuzu must climb a razor-edged ridge to continue.

choices.label: Question the cost openly
choices.intent: Zuzu chooses to question the cost openly with full responsibility for the outcome.
choices.risk: bearing check versus 11; mistakes may cost health or provisions.

success.text: The negotiator admits the price is obedience, not coin; Zuzu walks away with the truth intact.

failure.text: She answers in riddles until dusk, leaving him hungry and dangerously exposed.
